title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: when the monthly maintenance fee and the paper statement fee are assessed
content:
## Policy clause: monthly maintenance fee

1. At each statement cycle close, the tier's monthly maintenance fee is assessed on a Savings & Money Market Accounts account as one monthly maintenance fee for that cycle, unless at least one waiver offered by the tier is met for the cycle.
2. The tier used is the account's tier at cycle close.
3. The waivers are alternatives: any single one suffices. The fee is never prorated or partially waived. A waiver the tier marks "not offered" cannot be used.
4. The fee is not assessed for the cycle in which the account was opened.
5. The fee is assessed only on an account whose status at cycle close is active.
6. At most one maintenance fee is assessed per account per statement cycle.

## The waivers

| Waiver | Met for the cycle when |
|---|---|
| Minimum daily balance | the lowest end-of-day balance on any day of the cycle is at or above the tier's minimum daily balance waiver |
| Automatic transfer | the automatic transfer deposits posted in the cycle total at or above the tier's automatic transfer waiver |
| Age | the owner's age at cycle close is below the tier's age waiver |
| Linked checking | the same customer holds, at cycle close, an active checking account of a tier the tier lists for this waiver |
| Relationship balance | the customer's relationship balance at cycle close, measured on the basis the checking product uses for relationship balances with mortgage principal excluded, is at or above the tier's relationship balance waiver |

## Policy clause: paper statement fee

When the account's statement delivery is paper at cycle close, the tier's paper statement fee is assessed as a paper statement fee for that cycle, except for owners who are at least the tier's paper statement exemption age at cycle close.

A tier fee of USD 0.00 posts no fee entry, for either fee.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** Status, tier, statement delivery, balances, deposits and the owner's age are all read from the bank's records as they stand at cycle close; the linked checking account is read from the checking records of the same customer.
- **Object correlation.** The one-per-cycle limit is tested for the same account and the same statement cycle.

## Decision table for one cycle (monthly maintenance fee)

| Status at close | Cycle of opening? | Offered waiver met? | Maintenance fee already assessed for this cycle? | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| active | no | none | no | tier's full fee assessed |
| active | no | one or more | no | no fee |
| active | yes | any | no | no fee (opening cycle) |
| any status other than active | any | any | any | no maintenance fee |
| active | no | none | yes | no second fee |

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "Two waivers half-met add up to one waiver." **Correct basis:** each waiver is tested on its own; a waiver is either met or not, and the fee is never partially waived.

**Wrong reading:** "The tier the account held during most of the cycle decides the fee." **Correct basis:** the tier at cycle close decides.

**An owner is younger than the age waiver of some other tier, but the account's own tier marks the age waiver not offered. Does the age waiver apply?** No; only the waivers offered by the account's own tier at cycle close can be used.
